main.description: Create HappyProto's admin and customers spaces under HAPPYPROTO_DID, member-only, keeping either that already exists, and add each of staff to the admin space with write access, skipping existing members. Idempotent: a second call creates nothing and adds no one. Only HappyProto's own account may call it.

staff.description: DIDs to add to the admin space with write access. A DID listed twice is added once. A DID that is already a member is left at its current access (a read-only member is not upgraded) and is not listed in staffAdded.

staffAdded.description: The DIDs this call added to the admin space; members already present are left out.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HAPPYPROTO_DID, is signed out, or HAPPYPROTO_DID is unset or not a DID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: staff is not a list of at most 50 DIDs.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: A space could not be read, created or changed, or the instance anchors new spaces under its own DID rather than HAPPYPROTO_DID. A failure part-way through staff names, in its message, the DIDs already added. Retrying is safe.

uri.description: The space's at:// uri, at://<HAPPYPROTO_DID>/space/<type>/main. Not format at-uri: that format allows a collection NSID and a record key at most, and a space uri has four path segments and `space` where the NSID would be, so @atproto/lexicon refuses it.

created.description: Whether this call created the space; false when it already existed.
